source_contracts.adaptations: All three source flows retained. Commands map to migration analyse/search/gate/plan/reproduce; strict known requirement violations use MAIN exit 1. Copy follows the approved MAIN glossary. Separate MAIN proposal/state/CAS inputs replace the source combined package. The tampered-witness test additionally asserts a Failed reproduction record.

Version/build identity and doctor runtime/project separation retained for token migration, with MAIN schemas only and no network checks. Source default fixed-ratio init maps to explicit init --migration. The historical fixed-ratio dashboard store is an archived product format, not a MAIN migration input; the same no-config history access is checked on real MAIN migration runs. Dashboard projection coverage follows in T8.
